name: LISA: The Painful Vita
author: Pinol0
description:
Unofficial native port of LISA: The Painful (Legacy Edition, RPG Maker VX Ace) to the PS Vita, built on mkxp-z with Ruby 3.1 and vitaGL. The game's own scripts run unchanged and it is playable from start to finish.

- Screen options: 1:1, Original, Stretch and real widescreen (Wide)
- The 58 Steam achievements, unlocked on the Vita
- Combo keys on the face buttons and the right stick, PlayStation button prompts in battle
- MP3, Ogg and WAV audio

Alpha: very long sessions can still run out of memory, save often. No game files are included: copy Data, Graphics, Audio and Fonts from your own copy to ux0:data/lisa_vita/ (extract Game.rgss3a first). Runs well at the default 333 MHz; heavy maps drop a little more there, and the PSVshell overclock at 500 MHz smooths them out.
requirements: Your own copy of LISA: The Painful, Legacy Edition (RPG Maker VX Ace, not the Unity Definitive Edition). Game files in ux0:data/lisa_vita/. Overclock optional (500 MHz smooths the heaviest maps).
